vision.name: Red Android Twin Beams
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(Limit 2 per deck. If your MP does not have [Trait:Saiyan], when one of your effects requires you to lower your anger, you may banish this card from your discard pile to reduce that amount to 0.)
[Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Lower a player's anger 2 levels.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
(Created by Kevin Dennis, OP2 North Kai Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP2); prints a design credit line; inline icon zoomed: green S badge (Saiyan)
